description: make example EX=fsm: UART receiver whose state is a typedef enum (uart_pkg.sv), its outputs packed in a struct (status). No enum here: the FST dump brings the state names. Hand-written views, bookmarks and arrows; the Makefile passes the dump with --waves.

page.title: UART receiver FSM · state names from the dump
page.intro: An 8N1 receiver (4 clocks per bit) takes 0xA5, then a frame with a low stop bit that ends in ERROR. The state names come from the FST's enum table; edges are drawn in the questa style.

frame.title: first frame 0xA5 · clock-sampled
frame.note: a bookmark at every state change, on the signal that shows why; the arrows give the time spent in each state

bookmarks.text: START → DATA: rxd still low in the middle of the start bit
DATA → STOP: eight bits shifted in, LSB first; rxd carries the stop bit
STOP → IDLE: stop bit high, valid, data = 0xA5
DATA → STOP: second frame, 0x3C shifted in
STOP → ERROR: the stop bit is low, frame_err
ERROR → IDLE: the line is high again

status.title: the outputs packed in a struct (uart_pkg::rx_status_t) · exact transitions
status.note: the FST (Verilator --trace-structs) keeps the struct as a scope of fields: its row shows the whole 16-bit value, the fields below it
